Query: Evaluate [JSONata](https://jsonata.org/) expressions against DuckDB `JSON` values. The single function — [`jsonata`](#jsonata) — covers extraction, [predicate filters](https://docs.jsonata.org/predicate), [object construction](https://docs.jsonata.org/construction), and [higher-order array operations](https://docs.jsonata.org/higher-order-functions). The 3-arg form takes a `bindings` object so the expression can reference `$variable` names supplied at query time.
